advancements.tamedphantomscolors.dye_pha: Dye a tamed phantom or its saddle
advancements.tamedphantomscolors.glow_ph: Make a tamed phantom glow with a glow ink sac
advancements.tamedphantomscolors.brush_p: Brush the paint off a tamed phantom
advancements.tamedphantomscolors.shake_o: Release a painted phantom and let it shake the paint off
advancements.tamedphantomscolors.refused: Try to paint a released phantom
tamedphantomscolors.guide.page.colors.1: The owner can $(pet)dye$() a tamed phantom: use any $(item)dye$() on it with the right mouse button. The body takes the color, the eyes keep their own, and the trail from its wings turns the same color. Use a dye on the $(item)saddle$() to color the saddle alone.
tamedphantomscolors.guide.page.colors.2: A $(item)glow ink sac$() makes the phantom glow like a lamp: it is drawn at full brightness, and with $(thing)LambDynamicLights$() it also lights up everything around it. A $(item)brush$() washes the paint and the glow off the phantom and its saddle. The phantom gives a dry shake, and the brush wears a little.
tamedphantomscolors.guide.page.colors.3: A released phantom will not be painted: it bristles, growls, and attacks whoever tried for a while. When you release a painted phantom, it shakes the paint off in a colored spray and returns to its natural color. A saddle that comes off loses its color too.
